title: delphinium diversifolium var. harneyense
intro: Delphinium diversifolium var. harneyense, commonly known as Harney's delphinium, is a plant species within the delphinium genus. Harney's delphinium has been used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of Harney's delphinium include alkaloids, such as delphinine and ajacine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
